args.summary:
Model of a three-span cast-in-place continuous prestressed concrete box girder bridge (30+45+30 m, deck width 12.5 m, carriageway 11.5 m) was built and all L1/L2/L3 checks passed.

Idealisation: 2D spine beam (MR-01), system continuous_on_piers (MR-05) — the given pier column data are modelled as elastic beam-column piers (MR-06) fixed at the base. Single-cell cast box section integrated to A = 7.050 m², I = 4.777 m⁴ (MR-02); C55 girder Ec = 35500 MPa (JTG 3362-3.1.5), γ = 26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60-4.2.1), w = 183.3 kN/m, m = 18.685 t/m (MR-07).

Supports (2 bearings per line, MR-04): Abutments 0 and 3 = PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric (400×500, 5 layers), Pier 2 = PTFE sliding (550×650, 6 layers), Pier 1 = plain laminated elastomeric fixed (600×700, 7 layers). All modelled with zero-length springs (MR-03), Kv and S from JTG 3362-8.7 using the manufacturer's Ge = 1.2 MPa (MR-00). Piers: twin circular C40 columns D = 1.4 m, Pier 1 H = 6 m, Pier 2 H = 29 m (Ec = 32500 MPa).

Live load: Class I, 3 design lanes (JTG D60-4.3.1), ξ = 0.78, qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 320/350/320 kN per span. Modal analysis gave f1 = 3.239 Hz, so μ = 0.192 (JTG D60-4.3.2).

Key results — self-weight reactions ≈ [1811, 7843, 7735, 1858] kN; self-weight midspan moments ≈ [6546, 18945, 7244] kN·m and pier-top hogging ≈ [−28150, −26755] kN·m; live-load max positive moment 11254 kN·m (mid-span 2) and max negative −8975 kN·m. No unresolved issues.
